fields.claim: Rivermoor Bridge reopened to vehicle traffic in June 2023.
fields.passage: After an 18-month closure for cable inspection, Rivermoor Bridge reopened to vehicle traffic in June 2023.

fields.claim: The Calmerol trial enrolled more than 500 adult participants.
fields.passage: The Calmerol trial enrolled 612 adult participants across four clinics.

fields.claim: Northwind Robotics' warehouse in Dalton employs over 300 workers.
fields.passage: Northwind Robotics' Dalton warehouse employs 140 workers as of last quarter.

fields.claim: The ferry service runs seven days a week.
fields.passage: The ferry service only runs Monday through Friday; it is closed on weekends.

fields.claim: The museum's east wing underwent asbestos remediation in 2021.
fields.passage: The museum's gift shop added a new line of postcards and tote bags this spring.

fields.claim: Harlow Transit increased its bus fleet by twelve vehicles.
fields.passage: Harlow Transit's customer satisfaction survey had a response rate of 22 percent.

fields.claim: The new filtration system removes at least 99 percent of sediment from the reservoir.
fields.passage: Engineers installed the new filtration system at the reservoir in March and are monitoring sediment levels over the coming months.

fields.claim: Calmerol relieves all common types of joint pain.
fields.passage: In the trial, Calmerol relieved knee and shoulder pain in most participants.

fields.claim: Calmerol relieves some common types of joint pain.
fields.passage: Calmerol relieved every kind of joint pain reported by trial participants, including knee, shoulder, hip, and wrist pain.

fields.claim: Harrow Dam's spillway was completed in 2015.
fields.passage: Construction records show Harrow Dam's spillway was completed in 2018, three years later than originally scheduled.

fields.claim: Vitacrest multivitamins reduced fatigue in office workers aged 40 to 65.
fields.passage: A separate study found Vitacrest multivitamins reduced fatigue in college athletes aged 18 to 22, with no data collected on older adults.

fields.claim: The library extended its weekend hours by two hours.
fields.passage: Starting this month, the library will stay open two additional hours on both Saturday and Sunday.

fields.claim: Oakhaven Elementary's enrollment grew for the third straight year.
fields.passage: Oakhaven Elementary's enrollment fell for the second year in a row, according to the district's fall count.

fields.claim: The city council approved funding for a new bike lane on Birch Street.
fields.passage: The city council's next meeting will include a presentation on recycling collection schedules.

fields.claim: Northwind Robotics' new assembly line reduced defect rates.
fields.passage: Since the new assembly line went live, Northwind Robotics' defect rate dropped from 3.1 percent to 1.4 percent.

fields.claim: The marathon drew more than 2,000 runners this year.
fields.passage: Registration numbers show 1,840 runners crossed the start line this year, down from 1,970 the previous year.

fields.claim: Yearly rainfall in the valley exceeded the ten-year average.
fields.passage: This year's rainfall came in 15 percent below the ten-year average for the valley.

fields.claim: The bridge's new coating will last at least twenty years.
fields.passage: Crews finished applying the new protective coating to the bridge last week; its performance will be assessed in future inspections.

fields.claim: Daily ridership on the Blue Line rose after the schedule change.
fields.passage: Blue Line ridership climbed by 9 percent in the month following the schedule change.

fields.claim: Fernbrook Clinic opened a second location downtown.
fields.passage: Fernbrook Clinic's downtown location held its ribbon-cutting ceremony this morning, its second site in the city.

fields.claim: The firmware update fixed the battery drain issue.
fields.passage: After installing the firmware update, average battery life on the test devices increased from six to nine hours.

fields.claim: Lakeside High School's football team finished the season undefeated.
fields.passage: Lakeside High School's football team lost three games this season, finishing eighth in the conference.

fields.claim: The ferry terminal renovation stayed within its original budget.
fields.passage: The ferry terminal renovation ran $2.3 million over its original budget, according to the port authority's report.

fields.claim: The orchard switched to a new irrigation system last spring.
fields.passage: The orchard's farmers market stall sold out of peaches within two hours on Saturday.

fields.claim: Maple Ridge installed solar panels on the community center roof.
fields.passage: Maple Ridge's town newsletter featured a recipe contest ahead of the harvest festival.

fields.claim: The new checkout software cut average wait times in half.
fields.passage: The store rolled out the new checkout software last week and is collecting wait-time data over the next month.

fields.claim: The tutoring program improved test scores in every subject.
fields.passage: Students in the tutoring program improved their math test scores by an average of eight points.

fields.claim: The tutoring program improved test scores in at least one subject.
fields.passage: Students in the tutoring program improved test scores in math, reading, and science alike.

fields.claim: The community center's roof replacement finished in April.
fields.passage: Invoices show the community center's roof replacement was completed in September, five months behind schedule.

fields.claim: NeuroFlex headphones reduced reported ear fatigue among call-center workers after six hours of continuous use.
fields.passage: A separate review found NeuroFlex headphones reduced reported ear fatigue among marathon runners during two-hour training sessions, with no call-center data collected.

fields.claim: The co-op added curbside pickup for online orders.
fields.passage: Starting this week, members can select curbside pickup when they place an online order with the co-op.

fields.claim: Statewide applications to the apprenticeship program doubled this year.
fields.passage: Statewide applications to the apprenticeship program fell by 12 percent this year compared with last year.

fields.claim: The transit agency added real-time arrival screens at every station.
fields.passage: The transit agency's annual report highlighted a new employee wellness initiative launched in the spring.

fields.claim: Riverside Press shortened its average book production timeline.
fields.passage: Riverside Press cut its average time from manuscript to finished book from eleven months to seven.

fields.claim: Thornwell Dairy's milk recall covered three states.
fields.passage: Thornwell Dairy's recall notice named only a single state, citing a packaging defect at one plant.

fields.claim: Average response times for the emergency line improved this quarter.
fields.passage: Average response times for the emergency line grew longer this quarter, rising from four minutes to six.

fields.claim: The new packaging will cut shipping damage claims by half.
fields.passage: The company switched to the new packaging last month and is tracking shipping damage claims over the coming quarter.

fields.claim: Weekend attendance at the botanical garden rose after the new exhibit opened.
fields.passage: Weekend attendance at the botanical garden climbed 17 percent in the month after the new butterfly exhibit opened.

fields.claim: The park district replaced the playground's old equipment.
fields.passage: The park district installed brand-new slides, swings and climbing structures at Elm Street Park this fall, replacing equipment that was over twenty years old.

fields.claim: The clinic's new scheduling system eliminated double-booking entirely.
fields.passage: The clinic adopted a new scheduling system in January; staff say double-bookings have become rare, though a few still occur during peak hours.
